task: Add a fail-fast clean-tree preflight to review_run_start so reviewers never snapshot a working tree that is about to drift and cost a lost review round.
outcome: After this work, running lattice review_run_start while the working tree has uncommitted code or fixture changes prints a refusal like "review_run_start: git working tree has uncommitted material-source changes (M packages/main/src/foo.ts). Commit or revert all code/config changes, then rerun review_run_start." and exits non-zero WITHOUT opening a review run. With a clean tree -- or when only non-blocking categories are dirty (.lattice metadata / runtime artifacts / declared artifacts) -- review_run_start proceeds exactly as today and records the run.
facts: REVIEW evidence (finding_add / review_pass_set) binds to the review run headHash + materialHash captured at review_run_start; a mid-review commit staled it, and the only soundness guard is checkEvidenceFreshnessForGit at evidence-write time.
DONE gate precedent: done-oracle.ts evaluateDirtyGitStatus uses the shared classifier classifyGitStatusRows + DIRTY_GATE_POLICY (dirty-gate-policy.ts).
Per DIRTY_GATE_POLICY both material_source_changes AND fixture_changes are blocking; lattice_metadata_changes / runtime_artifact_changes / declared_artifact_changes are non-blocking.
readGitStatusLines is a PRIVATE (unexported) function in done-oracle.ts (~line 75); it must be exported or extracted into a shared helper before review_run_start can reuse the read+classify path.
review_run_start lives in handlers/review-run.ts (+ core/review-run.ts); there is NO clean-tree preflight at DEV->REVIEW or review_run_start today.
dirtyWorktreeClassifierOptionsForStory supplies the per-story classifier options used by the DONE gate.
constraints: Fail-fast UX only -- must NOT change the DONE gate verdict logic, the materialHash/currentMaterialHash computation, or the checkEvidenceFreshnessForGit write-time guard.
Reuse the shared evaluation (evaluateDirtyGate over classifyGitStatusRows) -- no new classification logic, so the preflight can never diverge from the DONE gate.
Export/extract readGitStatusLines WITHOUT changing DONE-gate behavior (byte-identical DONE verdict).
Block only on the policy BLOCKING categories (material_source, fixture); the non-blocking categories pass.
It is a convenience gate, not a soundness gate, and cannot catch a commit made AFTER the snapshot.
unknowns: Whether to export readGitStatusLines from done-oracle.ts vs extract it (and the classify/evaluate path) into a new small shared helper module -- PLAN decides.
Exact insertion point: the handlers/review-run.ts entry vs core/review-run.ts just before captureReviewRunSnapshot.
touchpoints: packages/main/src/tasks/ new smoke + package.json npm script
